caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate jug or pitcher placed centrally against a light beige background. The vessel is colored in deep, vivid blue with darker shading to indicate depth and highlights to suggest reflections on a glossy or glass-like surface. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body with a flared, short neck, a spout on the left, and a curved handle attached to the upper portion of the body and the neck on the right. Decorative patterns, including diamond shapes, cross-hatching, and starburst motifs, adorn the body and base of the jug. The base is round and flat, supporting the jug firmly. The artist's name, "JANET RIZA," is printed in small, uppercase letters near the bottom right corner of the image. No other objects or elements are present in the drawing, and the jug is depicted with fine detailing, emphasizing its ornate decorative features.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
